snippet.description:
The Hershey Chase Experiment explained for Class 12 Biology Chapter 19. This landmark 1952 experiment by Alfred Hershey and Martha Chase provided definitive proof that DNA, not protein, is the genetic material of life.

In this lesson, we break down the complete Hershey Chase experiment step by step. You'll learn how scientists used bacteriophages (viruses that infect bacteria) and radioactive isotopes of sulfur and phosphorus to track whether DNA or protein carries genetic information. We explain the experimental design, the key observations, and why this discovery was revolutionary for molecular biology.

This video is tailored for students preparing for Intermediate/FSc Part 2 exams under the Federal Board (FBISE), Punjab boards (BISE Lahore, Rawalpindi, Multan, and others), Sindh boards, KPK, and other Pakistani examination bodies. The content follows the National Curriculum of Pakistan and PCTB textbook standards.

What you'll learn:
- The background: why scientists needed proof about genetic material
- Experimental setup using T2 bacteriophage and E. coli bacteria
- Role of radioactive labeling with S-35 and P-32
- Centrifugation and separation techniques
- Results and their significance
- How this experiment confirmed DNA as the genetic material

Perfect for HSSC biology students, biology enthusiasts, and anyone studying molecular genetics. Whether you're revising for board exams or deepening your understanding of DNA, this lesson makes the complex Hershey Chase experiment crystal clear.

Like, subscribe, and comment with your questions. Share this video with classmates preparing for their biology exams!

Percentage Yield and the Importance of Stoichiometry is a critical concept in Class 11 Chemistry Chapter 4 for all Pakistani students preparing for Intermediate or FSc Part 1 exams. This comprehensive video explains how to calculate percentage yield, understand theoretical and actual yields, and apply stoichiometry principles to real-world chemical reactions.

Stoichiometry forms the foundation of chemical calculations and helps predict reaction outcomes. Whether you're studying under FBISE, Punjab Board, Sindh Board, or any other Pakistani examination board, mastering percentage yield is essential for success in your chemistry exams.

In this lesson, you will learn:
- What percentage yield means and why it matters
- How to calculate theoretical yield from balanced equations
- The difference between theoretical and actual yield
- How stoichiometry helps optimize chemical processes
- Step-by-step problem-solving techniques
- Real-world applications in industry and laboratories

This video follows the National Curriculum of Pakistan and PCTB textbook guidelines, making it perfect for students in Intermediate (FSc, ICS, I.Com) classes. The concepts covered align with FBISE and all provincial boards including Lahore, Rawalpindi, Multan, Faisalabad, Peshawar, Karachi, and other regions.

Perfect for exam preparation, homework help, and concept clarity. Subscribe for more Class 11 Chemistry tutorials and don't forget to like and comment with your questions!
